qe: In 1772 the Dutch Director at Chinsura and the Chief of their Patna factory represented against the payment of an annual tribute of Rs 30,000. Who were these two officers?
qh: 1772 में चिनसुरा के डच डायरेक्टर तथा पटना फैक्ट्री के मुख्य अधिकारी ने 30,000 रुपये के वार्षिक नजराने के भुगतान के विरुद्ध प्रतिवेदन दिया। वे दो अधिकारी कौन थे?
oe: Mr. Sohnlein and Mr. Van Braam
Mr. Van Dankelman and Mr. Eilbracht
Mr. Vernet and Mr. De Saumaise
oh: श्री ज़ोनलाइन तथा श्री वान ब्राम
श्री वान डांकेलमान तथा श्री आइल्ब्राख्त
श्री वर्नेट तथा श्री डी सोमेज़
e: 1772 me Dutch logon ne Bihar sarkar ko diye jaane wale 30,000 rupaye ke saalana nazrane ke viruddh apna virodh darj karaya. Yah pratinidhitva karne wale do adhikari the - Chinsura ke Dutch Director Mr. Bacheracht tatha Patna ki Dutch factory ke chief Mr. Falk. Inhone tark diya ki is nazrane ka mool uddeshya puraana ho chuka hai tatha jin adhikariyon ko iska bada hissa milta tha, woh ab Dutch ki madad ya nuksan nahi kar sakte, kyunki Bangal me hue rajnitik badlavon ke baad satta angrejon ke haath me aa chuki thi. Warren Hastings ne is maang ko turant swikaar nahi kiya; unhone kaha ki aadhe shatabdi purane record ki jaanch kar ke sarkar apne hi adhikar ko galat nahi thahra sakti. Isi kaaran yah vivaad 1770 ke dashak bhar chalta raha. Exam point: 1772 me nazrane ke viruddh pratinidhitva Chinsura ke Dutch Director Mr. Bacheracht tatha Patna factory ke chief Mr. Falk ne kiya; unka tark tha ki nazrane ka puraana uddeshya pura ho chuka hai tatha faayda lene wale adhikariyon ki satta khatm ho chuki hai; Hastings ne record ki jaanch ke naam par ise turant sweekar nahi kiya.

qe: The annual tribute of Rs 30,000 paid by the Dutch at Patna originated in 1716 as a payment for protection of their trade against whose harassing activities?
qh: पटना में डचों द्वारा दिया जाने वाला 30,000 रुपये का वार्षिक नजराना 1716 में किसकी उत्पीड़नकारी गतिविधियों से व्यापार की सुरक्षा के बदले दिया जाना शुरू हुआ था?
e: Patna me Dutch logon ka 30,000 rupaye saalana nazrana koi naya kar nahi tha; uska aarambh 1716 me hua tha. Us samay Dutch vyapar ko Chakwar naam ki ek shaktishali janjati ke utpeedan se bachane ke liye ek chhota-sa bhugtan Bihar sarkar ko kiya jaata tha; us janjati ka gadh Monghyr jile ke Begusarai ilake me tha tatha woh aas-paas ke vyaparik raston par hamla karti thi. Samay ke saath suraksha band hone ke baad bhi yah bhugtan badhta chala gaya tatha 30,000 rupaye tak pahunch gaya, jisme 15,000 rupaye sarkar ke kaam ke liye, 10,500 rupaye diwan tatha anya adhikariyon ko tatha shesh bhent-baant ke samaan kharidne me laga diya jaata tha. Isi kaaran Dutch ne ise 'nazrana' ke roop me nahi, balki puraani suraksha vyavastha ka avshesh maana. Exam point: 1716 me Chakwar janjati ke utpeedan se Dutch vyapar ki suraksha ke liye chhota bhugtan shuru hua tha; samay ke saath yah 30,000 rupaye ka saalana nazrana ban gaya, jisme 15,000 rupaye sarkar, 10,500 rupaye diwan tatha anya adhikariyon ko milte the; Chakwaron ka gadh Monghyr ke Begusarai ilake me tha.

qe: To settle the dispute over the Dutch tribute, Warren Hastings was inclined to reduce it so that Rs 15,000 be paid annually to the public treasury and Rs 5,000 to whom?
qh: डच नजराने के विवाद को सुलझाने के लिए वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स इसे घटाना चाहते थे, जिससे प्रतिवर्ष 15,000 रुपये सार्वजनिक खजाने को तथा 5,000 रुपये किसको दिए जाएँ?
e: Dutch logon ne apne nazrane ke viruddh jo dalilen di, unhe Warren Hastings ne poora nahi maana; unhone tark diya ki lambe samay tak bhugtan hota raha, isliye use prachin upbhog yaani prescriptive right ka sahyog prapt hai. Phir bhi unhone samjhauta karne ke liye nazrane ko ghatane ka prastav rakha, jisme 15,000 rupaye saalana public treasury yaani sarvajanik khazane ke liye tatha 5,000 rupaye Patna ke diwan ko uske 'due' ke roop me diya jayega. Dutch ne yah prastav sweekar nahi kiya; Chinsura ke Director ne ise galat thahrate hue nazrane ko poori tarah khatm karne ki maang dohara di. Is tarah yah vivaad 1770 ke dashak me suljha nahi, tatha aage bhi Dutch apne purane adhikaron ke liye pratinidhitva karte rahe. Exam point: Hastings ne nazrane ko ghatane ka prastav rakha - 15,000 rupaye saalana sarvajanik khazane ko tatha 5,000 rupaye Patna ke diwan ko; unka aadhaar prachin upbhog (prescriptive right) ka siddhant tha; Dutch ne prastav sweekar nahi kiya tatha nazrana poori tarah khatm karne ki maang ki.

qe: In 1772 Warren Hastings issued orders granting what to the Dutch Company as part of his reforms of trade in Bengal?
qh: 1772 में वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने बंगाल के व्यापार में सुधार के अंतर्गत डच कंपनी को क्या देने के आदेश जारी किए?
oe: Permission to build a fort at Patna
Exemption from all duties for ten years
oh: पटना में किला बनाने की अनुमति
दस वर्ष तक सभी चुंगी से छूट
e: Bangal me apna prashasan sudharne ke kram me Warren Hastings ne Bengal ke antarik vyapar ka punargathan shuru kiya, aur isi ka hissa hote hue 1772 me unhone Dutch Company ke liye 'Freedom of Trade' yaani vyapar ki swatantrata ke aadesh jaari kiye. Us samay se pehle Dutch tatha anya yuropiy Company ke vyapariyon ko dastak tatha aise visheshadhikaron ke naam par kai chhoti-chhoti rukavaten sahni padti thin, jinse unka vyapar prabhavit hota tha. Hastings ke is kadam se Dutch ko apna purana vyapar pehle jaisa chalane ka bharosa diya gaya, tatha angreji Company ne unse kaha ki woh unki 'ancient lawfully constituted trade' ko jaari rakhne me sahayata karegi. Aise kadam dikhate hain ki naye prashasak apni satta mazboot karne ke liye purane yuropiy pratispardhiyon ko bhi seemit rahat de rahe the. Exam point: 1772 me Warren Hastings ne Dutch Company ko 'Freedom of Trade' ke aadesh diye; yah unke Bangal ke vyaparik sudhar ka hissa tha; iske badle angreji Company ne Dutch ke purane vaidh vyapar ko jaari rakhne ka bharosa diya.

qe: In December 1773 Warren Hastings passed an order by which what was entirely taken off for the Dutch?
qh: दिसंबर 1773 में वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने ऐसा आदेश जारी किया जिससे डचों के लिए क्या पूरी तरह हटा दिया गया?
oe: The embargo laid upon the exportation of grain
oh: अनाज के निर्यात पर लगा प्रतिबंध
e: 1772 me vyapar ki swatantrata ka aadesh dene ke baad bhi kuch vyavharik rukavaten baaki thin, jisme sabse bada masla anaaj yaani grain ke niryat par lage pratibandh ka tha. Anaj ka niryat rokne ka uddeshya shahar ke bhandaron ko bhar kar mahngai rokna tha, lekin isse Dutch jaisi vyaparik Companyon ka kaam ruk jaata tha. Isi kaaran December 1773 me Warren Hastings ne ek aadesh jaari kiya, jisse Dutch par anaaj niryat karne ka pura pratibandh hata liya gaya. Is tarah ke kadam dikhate hain ki us daur me anaaj ka niryat keval vyapar ka vishay nahi tha, balki sarkari neeti ka bhi vishay tha; saath hi yeh bhi dikhata hai ki naye shasak purane vyaparik sahyogiyon tatha pratispardhiyon ke prati narmi bhi dikha rahe the. Exam point: December 1773 me Hastings ke aadesh se Dutch par anaaj niryat karne ka pratibandh pura hataya gaya; isse pehle 1772 me unhe vyapar ki swatantrata di gayi thi; aise kadam anaaj-niti tatha vyaparik hiton ke beech santulan dikhate hain.

qe: In April 1775 two members of the Dutch Council were sent on deputation to the Council in Calcutta carrying a Memorial of their grievances. Who were they?
qh: अप्रैल 1775 में डच काउंसिल के दो सदस्य अपनी शिकायतों का स्मारक-पत्र लेकर कलकत्ता की काउंसिल में प्रतिनिधि के रूप में भेजे गए। वे कौन थे?
e: 1774 ke ant me Calcutta ki Council ne Dutch logon ko bataya ki Fort William me Regulating Act ke tahat nayi sarkar vyavastha lagu ho chuki hai, tatha unse kaha ki woh unke purane vaidh vyapar ko jaari rakhne me poori sahayata karegi. Is bharose par Dutch logon ne April 1775 me apni Council ke do sadasya - Messrs. Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht - Calcutta me pratinidhi ke roop me bheje. Inke saath ek Memorial yaani smarak-patra bheja gaya, jisme Dutch ne pichhle atharah saalon ki apni shikayatein tatha badhaayen likhi thin; unka kehna tha ki unke purane adhikar tatha visheshadhikar samay-samay par taare hue hain, jisse unki Company ki sthiti bigadti gayi hai. Is tarah dekhne me aata hai ki British sarkar ke aashwasan tatha vyavhar me antar hone se Dutch ko baar-baar likhit shikayat karni padti thi. Exam point: April 1775 me Dutch Council ke Van Dankelman tatha Eilbracht Calcutta me pratinidhi ke roop me bheje gaye; ve apne atharah saalon ki shikayaton ka Memorial le gaye the; yah deputation 1774 ke ant me diye aashwasan ke baad bheji gayi thi.

qe: An agreement was made in 1774 for the supply of saltpetre from Patna to the Dutch, but how did the Council in Calcutta reply in November 1774 to their demand for more?
qh: 1774 में पटना से डचों को शोरा देने का समझौता हुआ, परंतु अधिक मात्रा की मांग पर कलकत्ता की काउंसिल ने नवंबर 1774 में क्या उत्तर दिया?
oe: That saltpetre would be sent only after the rains
That it was restricted from increasing the quantity by orders of its superiors
That the Dutch must pay double price
That no agreement had ever been made
oh: कि शोरा बरसात के बाद ही भेजा जाएगा
कि अपने ऊपरी अधिकारियों के आदेश से मात्रा बढ़ाने पर रोक है
कि डचों को दुगना दाम देना पड़ेगा
कि ऐसा कोई समझौता कभी हुआ ही नहीं
e: Bihar ka Patna shora yaani saltpetre ke vyapar ka bada kendra tha; shora barood banane ka mukhya kachcha maal hota hai, isliye us daur ke yuddh-vyapar me uski maang bahut zyada thi. 1774 me Patna se Dutch ko shora dene ka samjhauta hua, lekin unhe jo maal mila woh unki aavashyakta ke hisaab se bahut kam tha. Isi kaaran Hugli ki Dutch Council ne November 1774 ke shuru me Calcutta ki Council ko likh kar kaha ki pichhle kai saalon se unhe itna kam shora mila hai ki woh samjhauta hi poora nahi hota tatha usse unki Company ko bhaari nuksan ho raha hai; unki maang ki unka hissa badhaya jaye. Calcutta ne 7 November 1774 ko jawab diya ki unke upari adhikariyon ke aadesh se woh unka saalana quota badhane par rok laga chuke hain, kyunki unke apne hisse ka maal bhi unki maang poori nahi karta. Aisi patra-vyavahar dikhati hai ki Patna ke shora vyapar par poora niyantran angreji Company ke paas chala gaya tha. Exam point: 1774 me Patna se Dutch ko shora dene ka samjhauta hua, lekin maal kam mila; November 1774 me Calcutta Council ne 7 November 1774 ko dikhaya ki upari adesh se unka quota badhana sambhav nahi; shora barood ka kachcha maal hone ke kaaran yuddh ke daur me uska mahatva bahut zyada tha.

qe: On which ground did Warren Hastings justify the continuation of the Dutch tribute of Rs 30,000?
qh: वॉरेन हेस्टिंग्स ने डचों के 30,000 रुपये के नजराने को जारी रखने का औचित्य किस आधार पर बताया?
oe: Long-continued possession gave the claim the sanction of prescriptive right
It was compensation for Dutch losses in the war
The Dutch had accepted it in a written treaty
The Mughal emperor had ordered its payment
oh: लंबे समय तक भुगतान चलने से दावे को प्रचलित उपभोग का अधिकार प्राप्त हो गया
यह युद्ध में डचों के नुकसान की भरपाई थी
डचों ने लिखित संधि में इसे स्वीकार किया था
मुगल सम्राट ने इसके भुगतान का आदेश दिया था
e: Dutch logon ne is nazrane ko is aadhaar par chunauti di ki uska mool uddeshya samapt ho chuka hai, isliye woh ab vaidh nahi raha. Warren Hastings ne iske uttar me tark diya ki sarkar ka kaam aadhe shatabdi purane record khangal kar apne hi adhikaron ko galat thahrna nahi hai; kisi bhi tareeke se yah adhikar pehle lagu hua ho, lambe samay tak ek paksh ka bhugtan tatha doosre paksh ki sahmati use 'prescriptive right' yaani prachin upbhog ka sahyog de deti hai, tatha yah rashtraon ke samanya vidhan ke anukool hai. Unhone yah bhi tark diya ki sarkari adhikariyon ko milne wale fees unke pad ke dues hote hain tatha woh sarkar ki hi sampatti mani jaati hai, kyunki woh unke vetan ka hissa hote hain; isi tarah lambe samay se ek hi anupat me milne wale fees ko bhi prescriptive right prapt ho jaata hai. Is tarah Hastings ne vyavharik tatha vidhik dono aadhaar gin kar nazrana banaye rakhne ka paksh rakha. Exam point: Hastings ne nazrana banaye rakhne ka aadhaar 'prescriptive right' yaani prachin upbhog ka siddhant bataya; unka tark tha ki lambe samay ka bhugtan tatha sahmati ise vaidh banati hai; unhone adhikariyon ke fees ko sarkar ki sampatti maana, isliye vah bhi prescriptive right ke daayare me aa gaya.
